source_locator: R640: p. 213, 228-229; R634: Seventh Army troops, 276th Volks Grenadier Division (in route)
current_activity: The 276th Volksgrenadier Division attacks across the Sauer between Wallendorf and Bollendorf
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 9 p. 228-229: "its zone of attack defined in the north by Wallendorf (at the junction of the Our and the Sauer)" and "south by Bollendorf"; p. 229: "In the Seventh Army plan this division formed the right wing of the LXXX Corps"; p. 213: "South of the village of Wallendorf, where the Our flows into the Sauer, the 276th Volks Grenadier Division would push into the narrow segment of the Sauer front". Event definition: the opening of the attack on 16 December. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Wallendorf (PL0412), with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: the northern end of the attack zone Wallendorf-Bollendorf. Location support: the CMH names both ends of the zone, 5 km apart. Commander: Generalleutnant Kurt Moehring. Context: the Nafziger file of 26 November lists the division only as Seventh Army troops "in route", so the relation to the corps starts on the row date.
